Appendix A — Pitfalls in Portal Integration

This appendix documents all issues encountered during the integration of the Email Studio module (May 2026) — with cause, symptom, and solution as a reference for future modules.

A.1 Frame Problem: Sidebar Overlaps Content

Symptom: The module renders correctly but the left column is hidden by the sidebar.

Cause: Old standalone CSS overrides in mod-email_studio.css:

.main-content { margin-left: 0 !important; padding-top: 0 !important; }
.topbar { position: sticky !important; }

Solution: Remove all margin-left:0 !important overrides. The portal sets margin-left: var(--sidebar-width-collapsed) automatically.

A.2 base.html: extends and Block Structure

Symptom: No portal header, no sidebar, no dark mode.

Cause: Custom standalone base.html instead of inheriting the portal frame.

Solution:

{% extends 'abpe_ui/base.html' %}
{% load static %}
{% block module_css %}...{% endblock %}
{% block content %}...{% endblock %}
{% block module_js %}...{% endblock %}
{% block extra_js %}...{% endblock %}

⚠ Warning: {% block page_js %} does NOT exist in abpe_ui/base.html! Scripts there are silently ignored. Always use {% block extra_js %}.

A.3 Portal Wrapper vs. Own App

Symptom: Templates created twice — in the portal module directory AND in the own app.

Solution: In the portal module directory (apps/abpe_ui/templates/abpe_ui/modules/email_studio/) keep ONLY the module.json. No HTML wrappers.

module.json → ModuleScanner → Sidebar
→ Click → /email-studio/
→ abpe_email_studio/views.py
→ own templates

A.4 Duplicate Static Files: collectstatic Conflict

Symptom: Found another file with the destination path mod-email_studio.js. It will be ignored.

Cause: Static files in both apps/abpe_email_studio/static/abpe_ui/ and apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/.

Solution: Delete the wrong directory completely:

rm -rf apps/abpe_email_studio/static/abpe_ui/
# Correct structure:
apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/css/mod/mod-email_studio.css  ← Portal CSS
apps/abpe_email_studio/static/email_studio/css/es-components.css  ← App CSS

A.5 Wrong Language: current_lang from LANGUAGE_CODE instead of Session

Symptom: User switches to EN, but Django still renders with current_lang='de'. After F5 it works.

Cause: getattr(request, 'LANGUAGE_CODE', 'de')[:2] reads the browser header, not the user session.

WrongCorrect
getattr(request, 'LANGUAGE_CODE', 'de')[:2]request.session.get('language', 'de')

File: apps/abpe_email_studio/views.py — in ALL views of the app.

A.6 i18n Timing: loadLanguage without moduleId

Symptom: Labels remain in German. window.i18nData.es is undefined.

Cause: core-language.js calls on startup initLanguageSelector() → loadLanguage(lang) WITHOUT moduleId → _currentModuleId = null → modules/email_studio.json is never loaded.

Solution: In {% block extra_js %} exactly like cv_upload:

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (typeof loadLanguage === 'function') {
        loadLanguage('{{ current_lang|default:"de" }}', 'email_studio');
    }
});
document.addEventListener('languageChanged', function(e) {
    if (typeof loadLanguage === 'function') {
        loadLanguage(e.detail.language, 'email_studio');
    }
});

Key: loadLanguage(lang, 'MODULE_ID') sets _currentModuleId. Without moduleId the module JSON is never loaded.

A.7 i18n JSON Structure: Flat vs. Nested

Symptom: loadLanguage loads the JSON but applyTranslations() does not replace any labels.

Cause: _resolveKey('es.tab_templates') looks for translations['es']['tab_templates']. Flat keys do not work.

Wrong (flat)Correct (nested)
{"es.tab_templates": "Templates"}{"es": {"tab_templates": "Templates"}}

Tip: i18n_translator.py creates correctly nested JSONs automatically.

A.8 i18n Manifest: 404 Error in Console

Symptom: GET /static/abpe_ui/i18n/en/modules/email_studio/manifest.json 404. Still works via fallback.

Solution: Create manifest.json for all languages:

# i18n/{lang}/modules/email_studio/manifest.json
{"files": ["email_studio.json", "email_studio_help.json"]}

# And copy files into subdirectory:
for lang in de en es fr it; do
  mkdir -p apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/i18n/$lang/modules/email_studio
  cp apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/i18n/$lang/modules/email_studio.json \
     apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/i18n/$lang/modules/email_studio/
done

A.9 Bootstrap Icons: Icon does not exist in version 1.10.0

Symptom: Icon button shows no icon, but function works on click.

Cause: bi-copy is not available in bootstrap-icons@1.10.0 (even though document.fonts.check('13px bootstrap-icons') returns true).

Debug:

let found = false;
for (const sheet of document.styleSheets) {
    try {
        for (const rule of sheet.cssRules) {
            if (rule.selectorText?.includes('bi-copy')) found = true;
        }
    } catch(e) {}
}
console.log('bi-copy present:', found); // false!

Solution: Use an alternative icon: bi-files instead of bi-copy. Always check icons against the installed version.

A.10 {% block page_js %} does not exist

Symptom: JavaScript files are not loaded. No error message, no console output.

Cause: abpe_ui/base.html only knows {% block module_js %} and {% block extra_js %}. Django silently ignores unknown blocks.

Solution: Rename in ALL sub-templates:

{% block page_js %}  →  {% block extra_js %}

A.11 ES_CONFIG: Bridge Django → JavaScript

Symptom: JavaScript does not know current_lang, csrf_token, template.pk.

Solution: Inline script block as bridge in base.html:

<script>
window.ES_CONFIG = {
    lang:      '{{ current_lang|default:"de" }}',
    isAdmin:   {{ user.is_staff|yesno:"true,false" }},
    csrfToken: '{{ csrf_token }}',
    apiUrl:    '/email-studio/api/',
    activeTab: '{{ active_tab|default:"index" }}',
};
</script>

Then in JS always use window.ES_CONFIG.lang instead of hardcoded values.

A.12 api/set-language/ 400 Bad Request

Symptom: POST /api/set-language/ 400 for certain languages (ES, IT).

Cause: Missing try/catch around json.loads() + incomplete allowed list.

Solution: In apps/abpe_ui/views.py:

def api_set_language(request):
    try:
        data = json.loads(request.body)
    except Exception:
        return JsonResponse({'error': 'Invalid JSON'}, status=400)
    lang = data.get('language', 'de')
    allowed = ['de', 'en', 'fr', 'it', 'es', 'pt', 'nl', 'pl', ...]
    if lang not in allowed:
        lang = 'de'

A.13 Script Execution Order

Symptom: i18nData is empty even though loadLanguage was called.

Order in abpe_ui/base.html:

#ScriptImportant
1ABPE_CONFIG inlineAvailable immediately
2bootstrap.js
3core-language.jsDefines loadLanguage()
4{% block module_js %}Load module JS
5DOMContentLoaded PortalinitLanguageSelector() → loadLanguage WITHOUT moduleId
6{% block extra_js %}Register DOMContentLoaded WITH moduleId here

Robust Alternative: Embed i18n JSON inline via Django view — no async, no timing issue:

# views.py:
import json
lang = request.session.get('language', 'de')
p = f'apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/i18n/{lang}/modules/email_studio.json'
context['es_i18n'] = json.dumps(json.loads(open(p).read()))

# base.html:
<script>
(function() { Object.assign(window.i18nData, {{ es_i18n|safe }}); })();
</script>

A.14 Footer: Flat Keys Do Not Work

Symptom: Footer shows German text after switching to EN.

Cause: _resolveKey() only resolves nested keys.

WrongCorrect
{"footer.tagline": "Text"}{"footer": {"tagline": "Text"}}

A.15 ESHelp Modal: Language Not Updated

Symptom: Help modal shows German text after switching to EN.

Cause: ESHelp._helpData is cached. const lang = window.ES_CONFIG?.lang does not change after language switch.

Solution:

// Remember loaded language
ESHelp._loadedLang = lang;

// On open(): check if language changed
const curLang = (typeof currentLang !== 'undefined'
    ? currentLang : null)
    || window.ABPE_CONFIG?.current_lang || 'de';
if (!ESHelp._helpData || ESHelp._loadedLang !== curLang) {
    await ESHelp._loadHelp();
}

Quick Checklist

#Checkpoint
1base.html starts with {% extends 'abpe_ui/base.html' %}
2Scripts in {% block extra_js %} — NOT {% block page_js %}
3NO margin-left:0 !important in module CSS
4current_lang: request.session.get('language', 'de') in all views
5loadLanguage('{{ current_lang }}', 'MODULE_ID') in {% block extra_js %}
6i18n JSON nested: {"module": {"key": "value"}}
7manifest.json in i18n/{lang}/modules/MODULE_ID/
8Portal static only in apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/ — no duplicates
9In portal module directory ONLY module.json — no HTML wrappers
10Check Bootstrap Icons version before icon selection
11Check collectstatic for conflicts
12python manage.py check → 0 issues

Reference: cv_upload — the cleanest module

cv_upload is the reference implementation. The extra_js block as template:

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (typeof loadLanguage === 'function') {
        loadLanguage('{{ current_lang|default:"de" }}', 'cv_upload').then(() => {
            cvUpload.init();
        });
    } else {
        cvUpload.init();
    }
});
document.addEventListener('languageChanged', function(e) {
    cvUpload.loadUploads(); // Re-render data
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

A.16 New File Does Not Appear — manifest.json Forgotten

Symptom: New chapter/appendix is entered in meta.json and JSON file exists, but the browser only shows Content follows....

Cause: The documentation renderer loads files ONLY if they are listed in manifest.json. Without an entry the file is never fetched.

Solution: After each new JSON file, add it to manifest.json:

# apps/abpe_ui/static/abpe_ui/i18n/de/modules/documentation/manifest.json
{
    "files": [
        ...
        "new_module/11_checklist.json",
        "new_module/12_example.json",
        "new_module/appendix_a.json"  ← NEW
    ]
}

⚠ Applies to ALL languages! manifest.json exists only once per language — but all language versions (de/en/es/fr/it) have their own manifest.json that must be updated.

Afterwards always:

python manage.py collectstatic --noinput
supervisorctl restart abpe-django

A.17 languageChanged Handler Registered Too Late

Symptom: Language switch works in other modules (CV Editor) but not in Email Studio. 🎯 ES languageChanged fired never appears in the console.

Cause: The languageChanged handler in {% block extra_js %} is registered too late. initLanguageSelector() makes an async API call and dispatches the event — at that time {% block extra_js %} is not yet loaded.

Order:

#What happens
1HTML is loaded — {% block content %} script runs immediately
2{% block module_js %} is loaded
3DOMContentLoaded → initLanguageSelector() → API call → languageChanged event
4{% block extra_js %} is loaded — TOO LATE!

Solution: Register the languageChanged handler directly at the beginning of {% block content %} — NOT in {% block extra_js %}:

{% block content %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('languageChanged', function(e) {
    if (typeof loadLanguage === 'function') {
        loadLanguage(e.detail.language, 'MODULE_ID').then(() => {
            // Update labels
        });
    }
});
</script>
<div class="module-wrap">
...

DOMContentLoaded handler stays in extra_js — only the languageChanged handler needs to move up.

Applies to all modules that have their own templates (e.g., abpe_email_studio). Modules in abpe_ui/templates/abpe_ui/modules/ are not affected because they are loaded directly by the portal framework.
